acceptanceCriteria: Range impact reports the same unknown-verification line as path impact for Python and JS/TS changes (tests)
Go range plans stay byte-unchanged; NGI-V0 amended
body: Residual from V1-1827 (PR #1155): NGI-V0-059 adds the 'no language-specific verification command is known' line to range impact only when the range admits a .rb path; path impact reports it for other non-Go languages too. Listed as a non-goal of NGI-V0-059.
title: Range impact omits the unknown-verification line for Python and JS/TS changes (Ruby only since NGI-V0-059)
